en: This route deliberately narrows Bulbjerg to one known place for the evening. Bulbjerg combines deep coastal darkness with an exposed cliff and important bird habitat. The visitor parking area offers a defined landward position; Lild Strand provides a lower village-based alternative. This route makes Bulbjerg visitor parking area the only observing stop so attention stays with the sky and the known return. Lild Strand village edge is useful for a different date after its own current check.
